name: Virtualisation and Labs
summary: Build your own lab: several machines on a single computer, so you can test, break things and roll back without fear.
prerequisites: Requires the three operating systems: the lab is built on machines you already know how to install.
syllabus: What virtualisation is and what it is for
Hypervisor, host system and guest system
Building a study lab from scratch
topics: What a virtual machine is and what it saves you
Type 1 and type 2 hypervisors: the difference that matters
VirtualBox: creating, configuring and tuning a VM
Proxmox VE: server virtualisation with a web interface
VMware ESXi and an overview of Hyper-V
Resources: virtual CPU, memory, disk and acceleration
Snapshots: saving and returning to a previous state
Virtual networks: NAT, bridge and isolated internal network
Containers and VMs: when to use each
Building a lab with a client, a server and a target
Isolating the lab from the real network
